project.name: To-Let
project.summary: A university PHP/MySQL rental-listing platform for tenants, property owners, and administrators.
project.status: University project and prototype. Existing functionality should be preserved unless a requested change explicitly modifies it.

technology.frontend: Server-rendered PHP/HTML, Bootstrap 5.3.3 CDN, Bootstrap Icons CDN, custom CSS in style.css

configuration.note: Do not include or expose database credentials in user-facing output. database.php also adds approval_status to older local schemas when needed.

property_images.purpose: Image filename records for a property

requests.purpose: Tenant messages or rental requests for a property

application_flow.public_listing: index.php shows only properties where status is available and approval_status is approved.
application_flow.registration_login: auth.php handles both registration and login. Login identifies users by phone number and stores user_id, role, and name in the session.
application_flow.owner_listing_flow: Owner submits owner/add_property.php. The listing is inserted as available and pending. An optional uploaded image is saved under uploads/ and recorded in property_images.
application_flow.admin_approval_flow: Admin dashboard lists properties. admin/update_status.php changes approval_status to approved or rejected.
application_flow.tenant_request_flow: A signed-in tenant can submit a request from property_details.php. user/send_request.php verifies the property is approved and available, then prevents duplicate requests by the same tenant.
application_flow.owner_request_flow: owner/requests.php shows incoming requests for properties owned by the signed-in owner. There is no UI to approve/reject a request yet.

main_routes.index.php: Public property listing, filters, sorting, pagination, and BDT prices.
main_routes.property_details.php: Property detail page with 16:9 constrained gallery, owner contact panel, and tenant request panel.
main_routes.owner/add_property.php: Owner property creation and optional image upload.
main_routes.owner/delete_property.php: Deletes a listing when it belongs to the signed-in owner.
main_routes.admin/dashboard.php: Admin property listing with approve/reject controls.
main_routes.our-team.php: Static team page. Uses placeholder member photos, names, and designations.
main_routes.contact-us.php: Static contact page. Its form is visual only and has no backend submission handler.

shared_layout.header: includes/header.php starts the session, loads Bootstrap, Bootstrap Icons, fonts, and style.css, then renders the global navbar and opens main.
shared_layout.footer: includes/footer.php closes main and renders the global dark footer with links to all static pages.
shared_layout.container_rule: Header, footer, and main containers share width: calc(100% - 80px), max-width: 1760px. Mobile uses calc(100% - 32px).
shared_layout.do_not_break: Header must not close main or body. Footer owns the closing main/body/html tags.

listing_page.pagination: 12 matching cards maximum per page. Active filters and sort query parameters are retained across pagination links.
listing_page.cards: Four columns on wide desktop, two columns at narrower desktop/tablet, one column on mobile. Cards show available/type badges, image, title, location, owner, BDT monthly rent, and View details.
listing_page.images: Uses most recent property_images image_path. Missing images show a house placeholder.

property_detail_page.layout: Title and price header, horizontally scrollable constrained gallery, main content and sticky owner/request sidebar on desktop.
property_detail_page.gallery: Property images use a 16:9 ratio, object-fit cover, and desktop tiles constrained between 520px and 760px wide. Do not expand them into a full-width banner without user approval.
property_detail_page.visibility: Approved listings are public. Pending/rejected listings can be viewed only by their owner or an admin.
property_detail_page.price_display: Use `BDT ` followed by a formatted number, for example `BDT 15,200`.

design_system.visual_direction: Minimal, professional rental marketplace using off-white canvas, white cards, dark forest-green footer, green actions, dark serif display headings, and DM Sans UI text.
component_rules: Use Bootstrap Icons instead of hand-drawn SVG icons.
Avoid oversized hero/header gaps. Content begins close below the 60px navigation bar.
Use BDT, not the Taka symbol, for displayed rental prices.
Cards and image frames need stable dimensions so image sizes cannot move layout.
Team member images are square (1:1) because supplied member photos are 1254x1254. Team images should use object-fit cover.

current_limitations_and_risks: SQL is built by interpolating request values in several legacy files. Use prepared statements for any security hardening work.
Some legacy HTML output is not consistently escaped. New user-facing output should use htmlspecialchars.
There is no CSRF protection on forms or state-changing GET endpoints.
Owner deletion and admin approval currently use GET requests. Do not change this without coordinating the related UI and backend flow.
The owner request screen is read-only; request status management is not implemented in the UI.
The contact form is not connected to a backend handler or email service.
No automated test suite exists. Use php -l for syntax validation and manually check routes after UI changes.
The project may contain user-owned, uncommitted database and upload changes. Do not revert or delete them.
safe_change_guidance: Preserve session role checks and existing form action URLs unless the task explicitly changes behavior.
Preserve database table and field names unless a migration is included.
Run php -l on changed PHP files after edits.
When changing shared layout, verify index.php, auth.php, property_details.php, owner pages, admin pages, and static pages because header/footer are global.
